tracks.name: Mythos AI Executor + GitHub Bridge
tracks.current_stage: V2 (Haddad AI team, delegation, resource, unattended) merged 2026-09-23; MYTHOS_CORE_ENABLED stays false by ratified decision
shared_platform_capabilities: executor daemon + task store (executor.js, lib/state.js): fencing, retries, crash recovery, delivery
GitHub bridge: Issue → task → validation → report (bridge/github-bridge.js, bridge/review-gate.js)
agent registry + capability router + fail-closed allow-list floor (core/agent-registry.js, core/provider-router.js, bridge/provider-selection.js)
Claude model policy — explicit wins, scored haiku/sonnet/opus, fable never auto (lib/model-policy.js)
mechanical validation, reviewer-is-not-author, bounded repair (core/validation.js, lib/work-validation.js)
resource guard + GPU slot lease (lib/resource-guard.js, lib/gpu-slots.js)
deny-only unattended policy (core/unattended.js)
skills + trust ledger (lib/skills.js, config/skill-trust.json)
free-LLM pool + OpenAI-compatible provider (free-llm/, providers/openai-compat.js)
OTHKM read boundary, fail-closed (lib/knowledge.js, config/knowledge.json)
tracks.notes: Runs on the VPS (claude-code executor) and on Haddad (haddad-agent executor, isolated MYTHOS_EXECUTOR_HOME). Uses oth-knowledge through lib/knowledge.js and mythos-orchestrator/lib/redact. The Haddad instance is the same code, separated by environment, never a second executor.

tracks.name: Mythos Haddad — on-prem AI execution node
tracks.current_stage: V0, V1 (HAD-2/2b/3/4), V2.1–V2.6 merged 2026-09-23; HAD-3b MCP federation (17 tools) verified 2026-09-24
tracks.next_stage: V3.1 — FABLE director, Qwen default executor, Sonnet/Opus escalation, OTHKM as central memory (projects/mythos-haddad/docs/V3_1.md)
shared_platform_capabilities: local runtime: llama.cpp on Vulkan/NVK, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-Q4_K_M, 127.0.0.1:8600, ctx 8192 (GTX 1660 SUPER 6 GB, no CUDA)
haddad-agent provider: sandboxed (bwrap) tool runner with mechanical validation and bounded repair
haddad-health.js 17-check report + telemetry agent → Status Center /haddad/
Haddad MCP = oth-mcp server.js unchanged, over stdio, loopback HTTP and Tailscale HTTPS; federated as haddad-* through mythos-gateway
tracks.notes: Executes GitHub Issues labelled mythos:haddad for project mythos-haddad (config/projects.json); other projects need an entry there before Haddad can execute them. Claude is never the executor on this node (bridge allow-list = haddad-agent); Sonnet is diagnosis-only escalation. OTHKM store deliberately absent here (decision (a), 2026-09-23).

tracks.name: OTH Knowledge (OTHKM) — canonical MYTHOS memory
tracks.current_stage: OTH-K2/K3 canonical; Phase 16 propose → promotion gate; canonical store /home/deploy/othk-store on the VPS (activated 2026-08-20)
shared_platform_capabilities: read-only knowledge-service boundary (lib/knowledge-service.js)
append-only JSONL store with provenance, conflicts, bitemporal history
seed loader for reviewed structured knowledge (lib/seed.js, seeds/*.json)
propose → promotion gate → operator promote (lib/propose.js, lib/promotion-gate.js)
HTTP read facade (service/othk-http.js, :8150) consumed by oth-mcp
entity/relationship knowledge graph over OTHKM records (lib/graph.js: neighbors, walk, aliases) — typed relationships loadable from seeds since V3.2
compact context builder for an AI provider (lib/context.js: namespace, bi-temporal asOf, trust-ranked, bounded)
memory namespaces global / personal / projects/<slug> (lib/namespace.js, lib/othmode-memory.js)
tracks.notes: The single memory layer of the ecosystem; no second memory system exists by rule. AI layers only READ (executor lib/knowledge.js, oth-mcp knowledge_* tools) or PROPOSE; ingestion/curation stay on the operator CLI.

tracks.name: OTH MCP — controlled read interface
tracks.current_stage: 8 read-only tools on the VPS + haddad_health on Haddad; federated 17 tools via mythos-gateway (2026-09-24)
shared_platform_capabilities: knowledge_search/get, project_context, capability_registry, execution_status/report, budget_status, system_health, haddad_health
tracks.notes: Holds no data; every tool resolves to a system that already owns it. The same server.js runs on the VPS and on Haddad (HAD-3).

tracks.notes: Federates; does not reimplement. Registration of Haddad is scripted in projects/mythos-haddad/bin/haddad-cf-register.sh (PR #425).
